title.en: Bias from one certified reference material

description.en: Nordtest TR 537 §6.1: u(bias) from a CRM (11.5 ± 0.5) measured 12 times.
description.tr: Nordtest TR 537 §6.1: 12 kez ölçülmüş bir CRM'den (11,5 ± 0,5) u(bias).

explanation.en: For one reference material u(bias) = √(b² + (s_bias/√n)² + u(C_ref)²) = 4.15 %.
explanation.tr: Tek referans malzeme için u(bias) = √(b² + (s_bias/√n)² + u(C_ref)²) = %4,15.

sources.document: Nordtest TR 537 ed. 4 (2017), Handbook for calculation of measurement uncertainty in environmental laboratories

notes.en: Finding (F5): the handbook prints u(C_ref) = 0.25/11.5 = 2.16 % but 0.25/11.5 = 2.17 %, and its result u(bias) = 4.1 % follows from 2.16 %; the correct value is 4.15 %.
notes.tr: Bulgu (F5): el kitabı u(C_ref) = 0,25/11,5 = %2,16 yazar, oysa 0,25/11,5 = %2,17'dir; u(bias) = %4,1 sonucu %2,16'dan elde edilir, doğru değer %4,15'tir.

reference.en: Nordtest TR 537 §6.1, recomputed (the handbook prints 4.1 %, see notes).
reference.tr: Nordtest TR 537 §6.1, yeniden hesaplanmış (el kitabı %4,1 yazar, notlara bakınız).
